scene_analysis.scene_overview: A street view of a city street with buildings on both sides, lined with trees and featuring a fruit stand on the right side of the street. The fruit stand has a green awning and displays various fruits and vegetables including tomatoes, eggplants, zucchini, and other items. There are also black crates stacked outside the store.

scene_analysis.materials: The fruit stand has a concrete base and a glass front, with a green awning above. The fruit stand itself is made up of black crates stacked on top of each other.
